reviews.text: I’ve been bringing my rescue dog here for the last two and a half years. She started at 5 months old. She loves to play with dogs. Loves the pool and has her people there. I’ve had some interesting requests as my dog is my baby and they have taken care of every single request. Without question. Without fail. Penny goes to daycare here 3-5 times a week and boards a couple of times each year. She still loves going. Pricing is fair for the area and staff are knowledgeable and love pets.

Recently, our (almost)10 year old Pomeranian visited Boulder Falls (his first time ever being boarded) for a few half days to help him prepare for a 2 night stay. During his 2 night stay, we asked for him to be groomed, teeth brushed and nail trim. Everything was absolutely wonderful!!!! His cut was perfection, he smelled so good and his breath was delightful. We are so grateful for Tatiana and the entire staff at Boulder Falls!! They are so patient and attentive. "Thank you sooo much" to the staff at Boulder Falls for the great care you provided for Graham!❤️

I’ve taken my nearly 2 year old GSD, Meatball, here a couple times for boarding. He’s been to several other boarding facilities in his life. We can tell this is far and away his favorite place to go. When we pick him up from the other boarders, even if there is lots of group play, he losing his ever loving mind when we pick him up. When we pick him up from Boulder Falls, he is very happy to see us but not to the level of the other places we’ve taken him. Picking him up from Boulder Falls he seems a little sad to leave at all the friends he’s made, he is exhausted from all the play (if you have a GSD you know how hard it can be to wear these guys out!) and loves the people who took care of him.
The facilities are clean and I love that they have two adorable cats and other animals as lobby guardians and greeters. When we pick him up, he’s happy, he’s healthy and he’s clearly eaten his food. You can call to get updates to see how your fur baby is doing. The folks that work there are kind and attentive. This is hands down my favorite place I’ve taken him.
I love that (at least for now!) it’s easy to get him booked for a stay.
I’ll be taking him for daycare when I can and will update the review accordingly but I’m sure it’ll still be a 5/5 and Meatball will have loved it.
Adding to my original review since I’ve taken the doggo to their doggy daycare since posting and as expected, it was great! Meatball had a blast and came home totally exhausted for a reasonable price.

Once I discovered this place, it’s been the ONLY place I have taken my dogs for the past 20 years. Melissa and her team are AMAZING.  They know all the dogs and their personalities. They all go above and beyond. Every time I drop off my dog(s), I can go out of town without worry. We currently only have 1 dog and I can also drop her at doggy day care so she can play in a safe environment with other dogs. Truly the best team! They love what they do, they love and care about the animals and it shows. Also, whatever the groomer/bathers are doing to my dog, I need their secret. She has crazy fur and when I pick her up her fur is so soft and she looks so pretty. Thank you Boulder Falls team!

We hate being away from our old, blind, diabetic little man, but we are so glad to have found Boulder Falls! The staff rolls with his changing meds like it’s not a burden (I know he’s a lot!), and I love the triumphant greeting we receive when we (eventually) walk through the door! The staff is very kind, and we are grateful for how you care for our little Leko!

Our family is obsessed with this blue-eyed chonker, Martin Luther. He developed mats on his low back and under his chin, and because he was attacked by a coyote before he became ours, I didn't know how he would do being transported in a carrier again and we were nervous for him. I didn't need to be! At Boulder Falls he was given a bath, his nails were trimmed, and we were told he could have been fluffier but he hated the dryer 😂 We thought he looked amazing, his fur is smooth (and fluffy!), the mats are gone, and we can tell he feels fancy. Thank you so much for taking such good care of our boy (and us, by extension!)

We found this place on google after we moved here. Been here few time ma already and my cocker spaniel loves to be groomed there and he is not easy. He is excited about going. Kristine is amazing. She knows what she is doing. You have to book ahead but that’s not a problem. All the staff is very friendly. I’m glad we found a place like that.

We have a 10year old 100lb Mountain Cur, and 2 rescue pups, that have all been to Boulder Falls Pet Resort on several occasions. They absolutely love this place and the staff! Literally cannot wait to be taken back to the play yard! Even our old boy has the best time. Doesn't matter if it's the dead of AZ summer or middle of winter, I know my dogs are going to have a blast and be taken care of.

I don’t like leaving my dog, but I never have any worries when I leave him at Boulder Falls, I’ve been bringing my dogs here for many years, and the peace of mind they provide is priceless.
I love that I can call in at any time to check on him, and the staff are wonderful and patient every time I do. The facility is always clean, and the team is consistently kind and professional. It’s clear they take great care of my pup! I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, reliable, and loving boarding spot.

We love Boulder Falls! Our rescue dog, Yuffie, has been shy and skittish ever since we adopted her almost 10 years ago. She hated going to the groomers and her previous boarding kennel. Imagine our surprise when the last time we dropped her off for boarding, she willingly went with one of the staff members to go play! They all take such good care of her and I really appreciate that they allow us to provide blankets from home so our dog feels more comfortable. They also do grooming, and we love how soft and clean our dog is when we pick her up. Thank you for making Yuffie's boarding experiences so lovely.

I love Boulder Falls. They always take such great care of my dogs and cats. I never need to worry about them. And my fur babies always seem to have a good time. (When I've needed to board them elsewhere, you could really tell the difference in their attitudes when I pick them up)

They are always amazing every time I leave Remy in their care. I know he's treated like he's one of their own. They contacted me to inform me that Remy had been quite itchy.  They asked if it was ok to give him some Benadryl so he would be more comfortable. It was reassuring to know they were so observant and willing to reach out to me and let me know how he was doing and if they could help make his stay more comfortable. Thank you so much for everything you do!
We have been bringing our dogs to Boulder Falls for going on 20 years. We would never think of going to another place. A tired dog is s good dog. They get to run 5 times a day!

Boulder Falls Pet Resort is great! They always take such good care of our cat, Gentoo. This visit was his first full grooming and claw trimming, and he returned home clean, soft, smelling good, and a bit less sharp.

Their staff at Boulder Falls is friendly and professional, and their prices are both competitive and well worth the excellent service they provide. Whether you are boarding your pet, or looking to have your furry family member groomed, I would highly recommend taking them to Boulder Falls. 10/10 we will be returning again soon!
My boy Oliver loves going here, the staff is great and so friendly and I know he is taken good care of. The grooming is exceptional, and I will never have him groomed anywhere else but here.

Absolutely love Boulder Falls! They take great care of my pitbull Maisie (love that they don't discriminate on breed). They also watch my bearded dragon when we go away! Everyone is so kind and my girl always has a blast. I just wish that they were open Sundays, even if the hours were the same as Saturdays it would help out a bunch for vacations and even quick daycare stays.
My female boxer Ellie is very active. The staff at Boulder Falls does a very good job of taking care of her when she’s there. I highly recommend them…
